steps.en: Install the release, review access and connect your model provider
steps.zh: 安装发行包，审查访问范围并连接模型供应商

steps.en: Create an agent with instructions and send a bounded request with a file
steps.zh: 创建助手并填写指令，发送带文件的明确请求

steps.en: Start or resume the agent session in its persistent workspace
steps.zh: 在长期工作区中启动或恢复助手会话

steps.en: Leave the next request in the inbox while the agent is busy
steps.zh: 助手忙时，把下一项请求留在收件箱

steps.en: Queue follow-ups and return replies with managed attachments
steps.zh: 排队处理后续消息，返回回复与托管附件

value.en: Keep ongoing assistants and their handoffs together instead of copying between windows
value.zh: 长期助手及交接留在一处，不再在多个窗口间搬消息
